integrity: The classical Leslie–Gower map, equilibria, and qualitative attraction are cited as prior work. The new mathematical claim consists of the uniform quantified imbalance drift, the two-sided logarithmic passage clocks, and the critical-window composition profiles. Historical novelty remains qualified where relevant earlier full text was not accessible.
scientific_limitations: Fixed intrinsic growth a>1; symmetric positive rational two-population map; |epsilon|<=1/2 for finite-time estimates; near-neutral limits with fixed initial total density and specified weak composition asymmetry. No demographic noise, unequal growth or general multi-species theorem.
title: A uniform imbalance clock and two-sided logarithmic selection delay near Leslie–Gower neutrality
